notes.purpose: Opus and Sonnet (and Haiku, for a paired comparison in the same run) on the 12 text_rules tasks of profile hard, the only category on which Haiku failed in the 2026-10-27 probe (8 of 12). Question: does the stronger model solve what Haiku misses?
notes.cost: Estimate, NOT measured on this corpus: about 1 USD, extrapolated from measured per-call prices of the pilot (Opus 0.0464, Sonnet 0.0238, Haiku 0.0014 USD per ~6k-token call). Hard cap 1.50 USD set by the operator.
notes.delta: 0.15 is a smoke value; 12 tasks cannot establish non-inferiority.
